name: altean
description: Four connectors, one Salesforce analyst. Turns a Jira ticket into a one-minute solution brief grounded in your real org: Jira for the ask, Confluence for prior decisions, read-only DX0 for what exists and what breaks, and a read-only Salesforce connection for record checks only when they change the answer. Reuse-first, 2-3 options, one recommendation. Agents accelerate. Humans decide.
